episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of consistent client communication and how it can prevent lost deals. The conversation also delves into the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing that while AI can enhance efficiency, it won't replace the need for human emotional intelligence. Ben shares insights on managing a team and ensuring agents maintain daily contact with leads to improve conversion rates.
